originalSourceText:
Q.8  Why can compliant links or transmission systems degrade positioning accuracy in
        industrial manipulators?

      (A) Joint sensors stop functioning.

      (B) Tool position is directly measured incorrectly.

      (C) Forward kinematics assumes rigid components, while compliant components sag
      under load.

      (D) The manipulator loses degrees of freedom.

       Explanation: (C) Refer Slide 12 of Lecture Manipulator Mechanism Design-II

       Industrial manipulators estimate tool position using forward kinematics based on
      sensed joint positions rather than direct tool sensing. Compliance causes sag under
       gravity or loading, producing positioning errors despite accurate joint sensing.
